events.text: Controlled locomotion assay: a supplied single-cell precursor develops under gravity. Morphology and motor programs vary; net travel minus work determines artificial selection.

Jointed locomotion assay: supplied single-cell precursor, mineralized segments, angular limits and paired motors controlled by heritable recurrent units. Selection measures travel after growth and settling; it does not certify walking.
Locomotion generation 1: best net travel 1.76, work 2.67. Artificial selection retained the best viable program.
